proposedPublishedLabManifest.title: Mutations and invalidation
proposedPublishedLabManifest.expected: Create with a valid key; verify one 201, then a GET refreshes the matching list. A 422 must never produce an invalidation-based success state.
proposedPublishedLabManifest.security: A retry that regenerates the idempotency key may produce duplicate tasks. Avoid retrying unauthorized or validation failures automatically.

sourceContract.title: Mutations and invalidation
sourceContract.expectedPositive: Create with a valid key; verify one 201, then a GET refreshes the matching list. A 422 must never produce an invalidation-based success state.
sourceContract.expectedNegative: The starter sends a POST without invalidating task-list queries and has no idempotency contract.
sourceContract.securityBoundary: A retry that regenerates the idempotency key may produce duplicate tasks. Avoid retrying unauthorized or validation failures automatically.
